instruction: Create an LDIF file for a new person entry
output:
cat > /tmp/newperson.ldif << 'EOF'
dn: uid=asmith,dc=example,dc=com
objectClass: inetOrgPerson
cn: Alice Smith
sn: Smith
uid: asmith
mail: asmith@example.com
EOF

instruction: Create an LDIF file for an organizational unit
output:
cat > /tmp/ou.ldif << 'EOF'
dn: ou=people,dc=example,dc=com
objectClass: organizationalUnit
ou: people
EOF

instruction: Create an LDIF for adding multiple attributes to a group
output:
cat > /tmp/group.ldif << 'EOF'
dn: cn=developers,ou=groups,dc=example,dc=com
objectClass: groupOfNames
cn: developers
member: uid=jdoe,dc=example,dc=com
member: uid=asmith,dc=example,dc=com
EOF

instruction: Modify an LDAP entry using LDIF format
output:
cat > /tmp/modify.ldif << 'EOF'
dn: uid=jdoe,dc=example,dc=com
changetype: modify
replace: mail
mail: jdoe@new.org
-
add: title
title: Senior Engineer
EOF
